key_provisions_or_claims: Publishes references of harmonised machinery standards (Annex I) in the Official Journal, conferring presumption of conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC.
Publishes EN 474-1:2006+A5:2018 and EN 13241:2003+A2:2016 with restrictions (Annex II).
Withdraws superseded standards, including EN 1037, EN 61496-1 and EN ISO 12100:2010, on dates in Annex III.
Includes safety standard EN 50636-2-107 for robotic battery-powered lawnmowers.
Enters into force on the day of publication.
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/436 publishes, restricts and withdraws references of harmonised machinery standards under the Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC, determining which CEN/Cenelec standards confer presumption of conformity. It covers general machinery, with only incidental robotic content such as robotic lawnmowers.
annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/436 of 18 March 2019 on the harmonised standards for machinery drafted in support of Directive 2006/42/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council
